validity.recommendation: Reclassify PipelineType from 'distribution' to 'transmission', pending human review. This corridor is inspected/maintained by ООО «Газпром трансгаз Екатеринбург» (Gazprom Transgaz Yekaterinburg), a FEDERAL gas-TRANSMISSION subsidiary operating linear production divisions (ЛПУМГ) that perform in-line inspection (VTD) -- the same class of asset/operator as Gazprom's Unified Gas Supply System trunklines, not a regional distribution utility. This independently corroborates researcher NF's own 2023-08-22 ResearcherNotes flag ('Russian sources [call it] a transmission branch pipeline, but GEM does not consider it as such'). Contrast with sibling P3976 (see that row's own, lower-confidence classification note): P3976 is built/operated by a REGIONAL DISTRIBUTION subsidiary, so this finding does not automatically extend to the whole Kurgan отвод family -- each row's actual operator differs and should be checked individually, per the family-wide instruction.
